The '''''Incinerator''-class plasma railgun''' was a type of plasma [[Railgun/Legends|rail gun]] produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The ''Incinerator''-class was one of several exotic weapons produced by Czerka at the [[Time/Legends|time]], and it fired plasma bolts enclosed in magnetic fields. Like many rail guns, it had an extraordinary range and inflicted massive damage when fully charged. The plasma bolts did not directly pierce enemy shields but instead continued to burn a target after impact, inflicting significant damage over time to both shields and the hull.<ref name="Starfighter" />
